profiles.scope_note: Eora1 26 · basic prices. Locally verified native sets for 1990–2003, 2005–2017: 189 retained regions and 26 sectors. The 2017 inventory was parsed with MARIO; other locally held years were checked for source files and matching labels, not fully parsed. The publisher also has 2004, but that year was not downloaded locally and its sets were not checked. The 2016 local copy lacks labels_VA.txt; its VA matrix has the 2017 shape, so parsing that year requires indeces= pointing to a complete common label folder. Scope metadata only; numerical indicators are not published.

profiles.attribution: GLORIA v060, University of Sydney / UNEP International Resource Panel. CC BY-NC 3.0 Australia. Non-commercial MARIO research indicators: six native value-added rows summed; native GHG CO2eq converted from kilotonnes to tonnes, with direct final-demand emissions included once. January 2026 economic tables and April 2024 satellite vintage. No endorsement is implied. GDP adds source-signed product-tax and subsidy valuations on intermediate and final uses.
profiles.scope_note: GLORIA 060 / 1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025: identical native sets verified across readings. GDP includes signed product-tax valuations; native GHG characterisation is retained. Publisher series: 1990–2029; 2024–2029 are forecasts in the v060 release notes. Only the listed local years are verified in this explorer.
